questions.question: Paul wrote that God's eternal power and nature are clearly seen in what He made. What does that leave people with?

answers.text: They are unable to know Him

questions.question: Paul says people knew God but turned away from Him. What did they exchange the glory of the immortal God for?

answers.text: Images of mortal man and animals

questions.question: Paul says people did not see fit to acknowledge God. What did God give them up to?
Paul says people know God's righteous decree that such wrongdoing is worthy of death. What do they do anyway?

answers.text: Keep going and approve of others
Stop and turn back to God
Hide it from everyone around them
